Procreate brush files used as test fixtures for the importer (src/brushes/import/procreate.ts). All three are free to use and
redistribute. Their thumbnails (QuickLook/Thumbnail.png inside each) are Procreate's own picture of the stroke, which is what the
units were checked against (docs/brush-import.md, scripts/docs/ab-procreate/).

Sequins.brush
  Source: https://www.versluis.com/2015/01/procreate-stitch-and-sequin-brushes/ (the Sequins brush, 2015).
  Licence: CC0, as the page says.
  Changed: the only change is that Shape.png (the tip picture) was shrunk from 1024 by 1024 to 256 by 256 pixels, to keep the
  fixture small (the original is 279 KB). The settings, the thumbnail and every other file are the original's bytes.

Plain_Stitch.brush
  Source: https://www.versluis.com/2015/01/procreate-stitch-and-sequin-brushes/ (the Plain Stitch brush, 2015).
  Licence: CC0, as the page says.
  Unchanged.

Seed.brush
  Source: https://github.com/Leon-Schoenbrunn/CSP2PC (Seed.brush, 2025: the template the CSP2PC converter writes into).
  Licence: MIT, as that repository says.
  Unchanged.
